selectedTopics.title: System Design Basics for Feature Teams
selectedTopics.overview: A practical introduction to system design decisions for small feature teams.
selectedTopics.background: The team is touching more services and needs a shared language for tradeoffs.
selectedTopics.whyItMatters: Better design conversations reduce rework and make implementation plans clearer.

selectedTopics.title: Risk-Based Testing Before Release
selectedTopics.overview: How QA, engineers, and BA can identify the riskiest flows before a release.
selectedTopics.background: Recent work needs faster confidence without expanding the full regression scope.
selectedTopics.whyItMatters: The team can spend testing time where defects would hurt users most.
